lesson.grammar_point: past simple of regular verbs (-ed) + pronunciation of -ed: /t/, /d/, /id/

listenings.text: Hi Ricardo, it's Amy. Thank you for the photos of New York! I loved the photo on the Brooklyn Bridge. You know, I lived in New York for two years, in Brooklyn. I walked to work every day. On the weekends, I visited a museum. My favorite museum was the Met. And here in Miami, there is a good museum near the office. Saturday, maybe? See you!

Hi, it's Paul. My first trip to New York was in 1999. I was twenty-two. I stayed with a friend, in a very small apartment. And the weather? It rained every day, for five days! But I walked a lot, I visited the Statue of Liberty, and I watched a basketball game. On the last day, I wanted to stay one more week. I loved the city.

extra_audio.text: My first trip to New York was in 2016. We stayed near Times Square. It rained on Tuesday, so we visited a museum. On Thursday, we watched a show on Broadway. It was amazing.
